workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix flaky test_transformers_toolcalling_agent. Target files: tests/test_agents.py. `test_transformers_toolcalling_agent` runs the real `SmolLM2-360M-Instruct` model and asserted that its greedy output contains a parseable `weather_api` tool call. That output varies across CI runner hardware, so the test failed intermittently with identical dependency versions (2 passes and 2 failures on transformers 5.23.0 today, plus a failure on 5.22.1 on 2026-11-03; run links in #3179). (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/3180)

Fix: Fix pandas exception test for pandas 3 error message. Target files: tests/test_local_python_executor.py. pandas 3 removed `Series.bool()` / `DataFrame.bool()`, so the "truth value is ambiguous" `ValueError` no longer lists `a.bool()` among its suggestions. `test_evaluate_condition_with_pandas_exceptions` asserted the full pandas 2 message, which broke the Python 3.12 job on every PR (pandas 3 requires Python >= 3.11, so 3.10 still gets pandas 2). (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/3176)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix CI AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__'. Target files: pyproject.toml. Fix CI AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__': - Pin transformers != 5.13.0 Fix #2487. This PR makes a minor update to the `pyproject.toml` file to address a compatibility issue with a specific version of the `transformers` library. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/2488)

workarounds.symptom: BUG: f-string escape error in ToolSerializer.dumps causes uninformative error message
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: correct f-string escaping in ToolSerializer.dumps error message. Target files: src/smolagents/serialization.py. `ToolSerializer.dumps()` line 429 uses double braces `{{e}}` in the f-string, producing a literal `{e}` instead of interpolating the exception. Line 292 in the same file has the correct single-brace form. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/2134)
